reports.rationale: Per-employee computation of the social-security contribution base (IBC): salary value plus non-wage value, less items not applicable to SS, giving one IBC Total. IBC Total for an integral-salary employee is exactly 70% of the salary value (e.g. 24,715,285 -> 17,300,699.5), which is the PILA integral-salary rule tied to the IBC fields of Record Tipo 2 (pension/health/ARL/CCF bases) and to the Ley 1393 non-salary clamp. It is NOT the PILA settlement itself: there is a single IBC column (no split per subsystem, no parafiscal base, no days, no administrator codes, no rates or contribution values, no novedades). Title block reads 'Gross to net PMI' with the same payroll id as the Base of Withholding report, i.e. it is a tab of the G2N pack. Note: Employee ID values (e.g. '540521') do not follow the 8-digit pattern used in the other reports - join key to be confirmed.
reports.hypothesis_check: Partly overturned: PILA-related confirmed, but role is source (IBC working) rather than direct; no per-subsystem IBC is present.

reports.rationale: Per-employee monthly withholding-at-source depuration (Procedure 1/2 % Retention, income, mandatory contributions, AFC/APV, dependants, prepaid medicine, housing interest, 25% exempt income, 40% limit, withholding basis and withholding). Summing WITHOLDING TAX BASIS and the withholding columns over employees yields the Form 350 work-income base and withholding casillas, which the CO-DIAN-002 spec defines as the DEPURATED ET art. 388 base - so this is the working version of the payroll part of Form 350 (direct for CO-DIAN-002). For CO-DIAN-004/005 it is a source only (monthly values for AFC, voluntary contributions, mandatory EPS/AFP/FSP contributions that the annual certificate and 2276 accumulate), and for CO-DIAN-001 a cross-check of the income-tax withheld. Medium because two withholding columns exist (WITH / WITHOUT CONTRIBUTION) and which one is declared must be confirmed; also carries CONTINGENT WITHHOLDING, which may cover part of the 'Contingent Withholding Report' listed as not received.
reports.hypothesis_check: Confirmed: direct for CO-DIAN-002, source for CO-DIAN-004 and CO-DIAN-005.

reports.rationale: Per employee x wage type, one column per month (Oct-2025 to Sep-2026) plus Total. WT descriptions include salary (62100 Ordinary Salary, 62140 Integral Salary), statutory benefits (62211 Service Legal Bonus, 62150 Vacation Bonus), severance and interest paid (62110/62117 cash-out, 62126/62127 advances), severance-fund payment (25827/65805 Payment Severance Funds Inf.), cesantias base and balances (64998 Cesantias Base, 64999 Total Balance Cesantias, 63814 Severance Balance, 63815 Interests Balance), employee EPS/AFP/FSP (2554, 2556, 2553), AFC (25800-25808), voluntary pension FVOL (25811-25823), income tax (2552) and tax exemptions (58890-58892). These are exactly the annual accumulations Form 220 / Formato 2276 sum, and the cesantias liquidation inputs for CO-CESANTIAS-006. Caveat: the 12 monthly columns are a rolling window (Oct-2025..Sep-2026), not a calendar tax year, so the annual 220/2276 totals cannot be read straight from 'Total'.
reports.hypothesis_check: Confirmed (source for CO-DIAN-004/005/001); extended to CO-CESANTIAS-006 and CO-DIAN-002.

reports.rationale: Vertical gross-to-net for the September run: one row per employee x wage type with Amount and WT Grouping (Entitlements / Deductions / Non Cash Earnings/Deductions). This is the devengados/deducciones source for the Nomina Electronica document (CO-DIAN-001), together with hire date, leaving date, bank account and contractual salary. It also carries PILA inputs (64990 Social security base, 64991 Parafiscals Base, 2554/2556/2553 employee contributions, 2564/2567/2560 employer EPS/AFP/ARL, 25110/25111/25112 CCF/ICBF/SENA) and income tax 2552 for Form 350. Masking note: the 'WT Name' column was over-masked to NAME_ tokens, so concept names must be read through the WT Code against the Accumulated Report.
reports.hypothesis_check: Confirmed (source for CO-DIAN-001); extended to CO-PILA-003 and CO-DIAN-002.

reports.rationale: Absences processed in the period with wage type, start/end dates, days and amount. Codes present: 79001 Annual leave, 79003 Vacations Compensated, 79006 Maternity Leave Payment, 79008/79011 Sick Leave (employer first days / EPS reimbursed), 79018 Paid Leave. These feed the PILA novedades and their dates (VAC-LR, IGE, LMA, SLN start/end dates) and the Nomina Electronica vacation, incapacity, maternity and paid-leave blocks (start, end, days, amount). Hours column is empty. No unpaid-leave or occupational-accident (IRL) rows in this sample.

Employee master data used by every spec: split names (first, middle, last, second last), hire date, contract type, ARL risk class, AFP/EPS/severance-fund names, AFC and FVOL accounts, pensioner date, address, department, city, e-mail, phone, identity documents, bank data, tax procedure and basic salary. Gaps against the specs: no explicit document-type column (only separate columns per document), administrators held as NAMES not codes (PILA/cesantias need operator codes), no CCF, no DANE municipality code, no worker type/subtype. Masking note: 'Severance Fund Name' was over-masked to NAME_ tokens.

Despite the name, this is NOT a cesantias (severance-savings) calculation: every amount column is about the dismissal INDEMNITY (BASE / DIAS / VALOR INDEMNIZACION, e.g. 391 or 460 indemnity days), computed for the whole headcount (371) - a massive termination-cost simulation. It has no severance-savings fund, no days worked over 360, no cesantias value or 12% interest, so it does not map CO-CESANTIAS-006. The only spec concept it touches is the Nomina Electronica 'Dismissal indemnity' field, but that field reports amounts actually paid on termination, not a simulation, so no spec relation is claimed. Masking note: 'EMPLEADO' was over-masked to NAME_ tokens.
reports.hypothesis_check: Overturned: not CO-CESANTIAS-006 and not direct; it is a dismissal-indemnity simulation (client-only).

reports.rationale: Per-employee third-party deductions with the creditor/third-party code: libranza loans (BBVA, Occidente, Bancolombia), cooperative fund Foncoltabaco, union dues (CUT, seccionales), pensioner associations, funeral plan, voluntary pension FVOL funds. Purpose is paying/consolidating third parties. None of these concepts belong to PILA (FVOL here is voluntary-pension-fund savings, not the PILA AVP into the mandatory fund). The same deductions appear in the G2N, which is the source for the Nomina Electronica deduction blocks (libranza, union dues, cooperative) and for 220/2276 voluntary-pension fields, so this report is not needed as a spec source. Medium because the third-party 'Code' could be useful for the NE libranza description.
reports.hypothesis_check: Overturned: no PILA relation; client-only third-party payment report.
